title: Market Surf Report

conditions.headline: Post-Election Swell Settles Into Mixed Chop
conditions.summary: After Wednesday's big relief rally on the midterm results, futures are mixed: the Dow and small caps edge up while the Nasdaq dips on AI and chip worries.

sections.title: Futures & Overnight
items: Wednesday: Dow +3.0% to 53,356, its best day in about 19 months; S&P 500 +1.6% to 7,689; Nasdaq +1.4%.
At 4:25 AM CT: Dow futures +0.5%, S&P futures about flat, Nasdaq-100 futures -0.5%; Russell futures about +0.75% in a later snapshot. Early quotes are thin and sources differ.
10-year Treasury yield eased to about 4.89%; dollar index figure not available in this morning's sources.
WTI crude near $88.50 after an 8%+ drop Wednesday on Iran deal hopes; gold up about 1.7%; bitcoin up about 2.4% near $80,250; VIX near 16.8.
Asia: Hang Seng +3.7%, Nikkei -1.8% as regional chipmakers sold off.
Europe: stocks opened higher, FTSE 100 up as much as 1.1%; Bank of England expected to hike to 4% today.

sections.title: Macro & Economic Calendar
items: Main story: Democrats won control of both the House and Senate; markets rallied as election uncertainty cleared.
7:30 AM CT: weekly jobless claims (prior 194,000) and Q3 productivity (consensus +3.0%, prior +1.4%).
Challenger job cuts for October came in at about 44,000, down sharply from a year ago.
Fed: markets expect another rate hike in December; October jobs report due Friday.
Oil and geopolitics: reports suggest a full-scale assault on Iran looks less likely, keeping crude near two-month lows.

sections.title: Earnings
items: AppLovin beat on Q3 sales and earnings; shares jumped more than 16% pre-market.
Qualcomm beat on earnings but missed on handset revenue and flagged higher costs; shares about 3% lower after hours.
Arm's outlook did not beat expectations; shares about 3% lower after hours after a 5% drop Wednesday.
Snap, Zillow and MercadoLibre fell after missing estimates; Nintendo missed as Switch 2 sales slid.
Today: Toyota, ConocoPhillips, Duke Energy, Southern Co, Parker-Hannifin, Cigna, EOG Resources; Airbnb, Cloudflare, DraftKings, IonQ, SoundHound and Monster Beverage are also on the docket.

sections.title: Stocks in the News
items: APP (AppLovin): +16% — Q3 beat on sales and earnings.
QCOM (Qualcomm): about -3% — handset revenue miss, softer guidance.
ARM (Arm Holdings): about -3% — guidance did not top estimates.
SNAP (Snap): lower — revenue and user growth missed.
Z (Zillow): lower — Q3 results missed.
MELI (MercadoLibre): lower — Q3 profit missed.
CRWV (CoreWeave), IREN (Iren): lower — data center stocks hit by fears of tighter AI rules under a Democratic Congress.

sections.title: Business News
items: Democrats take both chambers of Congress; investors expect focus on healthcare, tariffs and cost of living.
AI infrastructure stocks sold off worldwide on expectations of stricter AI and data center rules.
Oil fell to its lowest since late August on hopes for an Iran deal.
Bank of England expected to raise rates for the first time in more than three years.

sections.title: What to Watch Today
items: 7:30 AM CT: jobless claims and productivity.
Whether the Nasdaq can recover from overnight chip and AI weakness after Wednesday's rally.
After the close: Airbnb, Cloudflare, DraftKings and IonQ earnings; jobs report Friday.

script: Cowabunga! This is Surf Daddy, your local Kahuna, live from Surfside USA to all you Trade Wind surfers from the Gulf Coast to the North Shore. It's Thursday, November fifth, twenty twenty-six, and this is your Market Surf Report. Sitting right next to me on the cabana deck is my furry co-anchor, Gus the wonder dog, still drying off from the dawn patrol. Give the folks a howdy, Gus! Let's check the swell. Yesterday was a gnarly big wave. The Dow jumped about three percent, its best day in roughly nineteen months, as Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate and election jitters washed out. This morning the water is choppier. As of about four thirty A M Central, Dow futures are up about half a percent and Russell futures are up close to three quarters of a percent, but Nasdaq one hundred futures are down about half a percent and S and P futures are basically flat. Early quotes are thin and moving around, so ride with care. The ten year Treasury yield eased to about four point eight nine percent. Crude oil is near eighty eight dollars after an eight percent wipeout yesterday on hopes for an Iran deal. Gold is up nearly two percent, bitcoin is up about two percent near eighty thousand, and the VIX sits near seventeen. Overseas, Hong Kong surged almost four percent, the Nikkei slipped nearly two percent as chip stocks sold off, and Europe opened higher, with the Bank of England expected to raise rates today. Now the wind and weather. At seven thirty A M Central we get weekly jobless claims and third quarter productivity, with productivity expected up about three percent. Challenger job cuts already came in lower than a year ago. The big one is Friday's October jobs report. The tide chart. Qualcomm beat on earnings but slid about three percent after hours on a soft handset business and higher costs. Arm fell about three percent late after a guidance that did not wow anyone. But AppLovin hung ten, jumping more than sixteen percent before the bell after beating on sales and earnings. That calls for a treat, Gus! Here you go, buddy! In the lineup, Snap, Zillow and MercadoLibre are under pressure after misses. Data center names like CoreWeave and Iren are wiping out on fears of tighter A I rules from the new Congress. That's a reminder that the hype boards can turn into hodads fast. Beach talk: oil is the story, with talk of a possible Iran deal, and Washington is bracing for a new balance of power. Reporting today: Airbnb, Cloudflare, DraftKings, IonQ, ConocoPhillips, Duke Energy and Toyota. Sets to watch: seven thirty jobless claims, the Bank of England decision, and whether tech can paddle back from that Nasdaq dip. Got a stock, E T F or futures contract on your mind? Type it into the Check a Wave box on the page, and Surf Daddy will call it for you. Stay stoked, soul surfers. This is information, not advice. This is Surf Daddy and Gus the wonder dog saying, if in doubt, paddle out!
